text:
maya: cc @jonathan @anya — after onboarding fp8-opt-phi yesterday, the scorecard delta chart flips sign for the intent-classifier cohort. Drilldown rows are shifted and exported CSV has wrong variant_id for many samples.
jonathan: ugh. UI or backend issue? can you paste repro steps/screens?
maya: UI. Steps: Scorecards > Cohorts > Intent classifier > click delta heatmap cell > click "Show samples". Modal shows variant_id that doesn't match the sample timestamps. Screenshot: https://redwood.screens/abc123
anya: saw something similar in quant run 2026-03-18 in CI. samplemap_integrity check failed intermittently. Might be runner mapping off-by-one when quantized artifacts reuse base names.
sam: we changed artifact naming last week: `model-<name>-<quant>-<commit>` -> we removed commit timestamp to make names shorter. could be collisions if commit hashes are identical-ish across builds.
jonathan: frontend uses artifact_name to label rows. If names collide frontend SQL `max()` will pick arbitrary row. quick fix: join also on build_id or artifact_digest.
maya: repro snippet:
```
# quick local repro
from runner import fetch_samples
s = fetch_samples('/scorecard/intent-classifier', variant='fp8-opt-phi')
print(s[0]['variant_id'], s[0]['prompt'][:80])
```
ci-bot: CI: quant-eval-run #492 failed samplemap_integrity check
anya: :thinking_face: was there an evalboard alert yesterday? I remember a suppressed noise alert.
maya: alert did fire but was filtered. I re-enabled it — attaching small CSV excerpt: variant_id column shows ['fp8-opt-phi','fp8-opt-phi','fp8-base','fp8-opt-phi'] but the sample timestamps imply the third row should be fp8-opt-phi as well.
jonathan: I'll add build_id to the drilldown query and show artifact_digest in export UI. will open a tiny PR.
sam: long-term: runner should include artifact_digest in samplemap rows so exports are deterministic. also add a CI assertion that artifact_name+build_id is unique per run.
maya: can someone add a quick guard in export code to include digest? sales already saw wrong cost attribution because billing linked to variant_id.
lee: noted, finance will audit affected exports and flag any billing mismatches.
anya: opening ticket ENG-ML-731: "runner: embed artifact_digest in samplemap + uniqueness checks". linking CI run #492 and this thread. ETA EOD tomorrow.
jonathan: :thumbsup: PR for UI change coming in a few mins (will link here).
maya: thanks all. putting this in the weekly standup blockers list. if anyone finds more instances, drop them here.
lee: I'll follow up after audit. thanks for the quick triage!
